name: Paliano
description: Paliano, also called the High City, is the capital city of the plane of Fiora, a place of intrigue and political factions.

summary.text: Paliano, also called the High City, is the capital city of the plane of Fiora, a place of intrigue and political factions.

bio.text: Count Brago and Selvala drafted the Charter that forged Paliano, and Brago became king of the High City.

citations.text: "Betrayal" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 May 2014.
"Betrayal" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 May 2014.
"Betrayal" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 May 2014.

bio.text: Marchesa kept a mansion among the elite homes of the High City, where she entertained her business partner Ervos Trax at dinner.

citations.text: "The Black Rose" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 May 2014.
"The Black Rose" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 May 2014.

bio.text: Muzzio kept a scale model of Paliano in his hidden workshop alongside an army of constructs.

citations.text: "Like Cogwork" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 May 2014.

bio.text: Marchesa was later crowned queen of the High City and styled herself its sole sovereign.

citations.text: "Tyrants" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2016.
"Proclamation by Queen Marchesa" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2016.

bio.text: The city celebrated the Festival of Our Sovereign Lady's Grace while it was in political chaos.

citations.text: "Bloody Instructions" by Shawn Main and Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2016.

bio.text: Daretti returned to Fiora to reshape the power structures of Paliano.

citations.text: "Daretti". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

status.text: As of the latest story, Paliano is ruled by Queen Marchesa, who is crowned queen and styles herself sole sovereign of the High City.

citations.text: "Tyrants" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2016.
"Proclamation by Queen Marchesa" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Cogwork is eliminated from Paliano's streets after a bid for power by Muzzio.
timeline.quote: cogwork was eliminated from the streets of Paliano after a bid for power by Muzzio

citation.text: "Fiora", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Selvala kills the immortal Brago, inadvertently releasing him as a spirit to rule eternally.
timeline.quote: his ally Selvala of Alberon killed him

citation.text: "Fiora", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Marchesa hires Kaya Cassir to put Brago to rest.
timeline.quote: the noblewoman Marchesa d'Amati hired the ghost assassin Kaya Cassir to finally put Brago to rest

citation.text: "Fiora", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Adriana Vallore foments rebellion while Daretti instigates the goblin riots.
timeline.quote: the Fioran goblin planeswalker Daretti instigated the goblin riots

citation.text: "Fiora", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At a private dinner, Selvala tells the withered King Brago that he is no longer the king she remembers and that she begged him to refuse the Custodi's treatments.
timeline.quote: I begged you not to let the Custodi begin their treatments.

citation.text: "Betrayal" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 May 2014.

timeline.summary: Flashback: young Count Brago sees the potential of the City and recognizes he cannot walk the path to it alone.
timeline.quote: And he could not walk it alone.

citation.text: "Betrayal" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 May 2014.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Brago and Selvala work inseparably, build a coalition, and together draft the Charter that forges Paliano.
timeline.quote: Together, they drafted the Charter.

citation.text: "Betrayal" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 May 2014.

timeline.summary: Flashback: three years into his reign, Brago is diagnosed with an incurable hereditary illness, and he and Selvala reluctantly agree to the priests' magical preservation treatments.
timeline.quote: The Custodi were formed, and the king lived.

citation.text: "Betrayal" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 May 2014.

timeline.summary: Selvala accuses Brago of valuing his own life above those he served and says she would call any other man who spoke so a tyrant.
timeline.quote: if I heard those words from any other man's lips, I would know him to be a tyrant.

citation.text: "Betrayal" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 May 2014.

timeline.summary: Brago reveals there will be no more treatments because they have gone too far, and begs Selvala to kill him.
timeline.quote: I cannot die naturally. But I think I must die.

citation.text: "Betrayal" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 May 2014.

timeline.summary: Selvala forgives Brago and stabs him through the heart; his body crumbles to dust as he whispers that she will not, and she is escorted from the room.
timeline.quote: His ancient body began to crumble almost immediately

citation.text: "Betrayal" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 May 2014.

timeline.summary: The Custodi gather in the throne room to plan how to retain power after the king's death.
timeline.quote: The King is dead.

citation.text: "Betrayal" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 May 2014.

timeline.summary: Brago's spirit appears in a blue mist and orders the Custodi to announce that the king has risen and that their work is complete; they hail him as King Eternal.
timeline.quote: All hail Brago, King Eternal.

citation.text: "Betrayal" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 May 2014.

timeline.summary: Marchesa entertains her longtime business partner Ervos Trax at dinner in her mansion in Paliano.
timeline.quote: Marchesa was entertaining a guest and business partner from the lowlands, Ervos Trax.

citation.text: "The Black Rose" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 May 2014.

timeline.summary: Ervos announces over dinner that he is going to have Marchesa killed, because his network is moving into the High City and she is his only obstacle.
timeline.quote: I think I am going to have you killed

citation.text: "The Black Rose" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 May 2014.

timeline.summary: Ervos walks Marchesa through why a direct attack or poisoning would fail, noting her zombie guards, escape routes and food precautions.
timeline.quote: So, killing you through your food would be out of the question.

citation.text: "The Black Rose" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 May 2014.

timeline.summary: Ervos explains the plan to corrupt a trusted lieutenant such as Pietro Lokosh, and Marchesa names him before Ervos does.
timeline.quote: Pietro Lokosh?

citation.text: "The Black Rose" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 May 2014.

timeline.summary: Ervos, coughing blood, reveals that he has poisoned himself because one of them would have to die.
timeline.quote: So instead of letting you kill me, I would poison myself

citation.text: "The Black Rose" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 May 2014.

timeline.summary: Marchesa admits she planned to have Ervos killed in two nights and that she will now be blamed; she praises his play.
timeline.quote: I had planned to have you killed at your secret penthouse in your sleep two nights from now.

citation.text: "The Black Rose" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 May 2014.

timeline.summary: Ervos dies slumped into his plate, and Marchesa leaves to summon her butler, who has already dug a hole for the body.
timeline.quote: then slumped forward, face into his plate, dead.

citation.text: "The Black Rose" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 May 2014.

timeline.summary: Muzzio, upset at losing the vice chancellor vote, summons his apprentice Irie to his workshop to accelerate his training.
timeline.quote: he had summoned for his apprentice, Irie.

citation.text: "Like Cogwork" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 May 2014.

timeline.summary: Muzzio reveals his hidden workshop containing an army of constructs and a scale model of Paliano, and Irie pretends to see it for the first time.
timeline.quote: The centerpiece of the room, surrounded by whirring noises of various machines and the iron army, was a scale model of Paliano

citation.text: "Like Cogwork" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 May 2014.

timeline.summary: Muzzio denies ever having killed anyone and reveals that his constructs record everything people say onto wax cylinders.
timeline.quote: Within each of the constructs is a series of needles that transcribes all that they hear onto wax cylinders

citation.text: "Like Cogwork" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 May 2014.

timeline.summary: Muzzio explains his grand design to mitigate human variables and says the vice chancellorship would have given him the autonomy for the next phase; Brago's death and seeming ascension made the board cautious.
timeline.quote: But the death of Brago and his seeming ascension, which I couldn't foresee, caused them to vote more cautiously.

citation.text: "Like Cogwork" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 May 2014.

timeline.summary: Muzzio's constructs erase Professor Emralla's money and registration of her estate, leaving her facing eviction.
timeline.quote: Professor Emralla found that the bank no longer had record of her money.

citation.text: "Like Cogwork" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 May 2014.

timeline.summary: Tulando finds forged papers framing him for embezzlement and dealings with Ervos Trax on his breakfast table, and resigns within the hour.
timeline.quote: He resigned less than an hour later.

citation.text: "Like Cogwork" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 May 2014.

timeline.summary: A construct records Chancellor Grinaldi's affair and an envelope exposing it is left for his wife, forcing him to leave his position.
timeline.quote: The chancellor was forced to leave his position to fix his personal life.

citation.text: "Like Cogwork" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 May 2014.

timeline.summary: Selvala sits in isolation in a dungeon cell among insects, hearing the dungeon keeper taunt her; she had earlier dealt with goblins who came to her door.
timeline.quote: She'd dealt with each of them in turn.

citation.text: "Blood Will Have Blood". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jun 2014. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Selvala tells Grenzo she is armed with a sharpened femur; he reveals she took the eye of one of his best agents with it.
timeline.quote: Selvala smiled and fingered the crudely sharpened weapon at her side.

citation.text: "Blood Will Have Blood". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jun 2014. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Grenzo asks what it is like to kill a man you love, and Selvala answers that it is all too easy; he unlocks the cell door.
timeline.quote: Selvala said, "All too easy."

citation.text: "Blood Will Have Blood". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jun 2014. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Grenzo leads Selvala through the tunnels under Paliano, pointing out the palace, Brago's bedchamber, Sydri's shop and the treasury.
timeline.quote: Slowly, the map of Paliano began to make sense to her

citation.text: "Blood Will Have Blood". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jun 2014. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Grenzo offers Selvala gold, access, information or the chance to kill an enemy.
timeline.quote: "What about the opportunity to kill an enemy for a change?"

citation.text: "Blood Will Have Blood". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jun 2014. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Selvala flees through the sewers with Muzzio's tomes while automata chase her, and Grenzo's killers and Muzzio's artificial animals are about to clash.
timeline.quote: Soon they would clash—Grenzo's secret killers and Muzzio's artificial animals

citation.text: "Blood Will Have Blood". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jun 2014. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Selvala hides in an unlocked cell and plans to leave the High City for the wild the next day.
timeline.quote: She found an unlocked cell and crawled into the corner with the beetles.

citation.text: "Blood Will Have Blood". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jun 2014. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Kaya receives an unmarked envelope bearing only the Black Rose symbol, signalling that her big job has begun.
timeline.quote: just a symbol. The Black Rose.

citation.text: "Laid to Rest" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Kaya tells Revari the ghost is dealt with, and he insists on inspecting the manor before paying.
timeline.quote: I can't be faulted for wishing to inspect your work before remitting payment.

citation.text: "Laid to Rest" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Adriana stands guard as King Brago, now a paranoid ghost, meets with two Custodi ghosts in the great dining hall.
timeline.quote: King Brago sat at the head of his dining room table before a clean plate and sparkling silverware

citation.text: "Tyrants" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Adriana recalls being ordered to dismantle the Academy and purge invention from the city.
timeline.quote: To dismantle the Academy, to purge the pursuit of invention and innovation from the city.

citation.text: "Tyrants" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: The Custodi bless Adriana with a formal goodbye before leaving.
timeline.quote: Adriana received the blessing willingly

citation.text: "Tyrants" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Adriana finds a servant girl throwing out the crown's plates because Her Ladyship dislikes them, hinting at a coming queen.
timeline.quote: Boss told us that Her Ladyship didn't like the plates,

citation.text: "Tyrants" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Adriana bursts into the dining hall to find Kaya driving a rondel dagger into King Brago's neck.
timeline.quote: a rondel dagger buried deep in the neck of her king

citation.text: "Tyrants" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Adriana swings her sword through Brago's face at the assassin, but Kaya turns translucent and it passes harmlessly.
timeline.quote: She drew her sword and swung it directly through the face of King Brago

citation.text: "Tyrants" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: King Brago dies a second death as a violet necrosis dissolves his ghostly form, leaving his armor and crown.
timeline.quote: in a matter of seconds the king's form had vanished.

citation.text: "Tyrants" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Adriana attacks Kaya with Brago's sword, but Kaya turns phantom and grins at her shock.
timeline.quote: In an instant the assassin's stomach turned a bizarre and translucent violet

citation.text: "Tyrants" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Kaya says she was paid to hit only one mark and will not kill Adriana.
timeline.quote: I was paid to hit only one mark. I'm not going to kill you,

citation.text: "Tyrants" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Kaya tells Adriana that as long as tyrants die, freedom lives, and Adriana is struck by guilt.
timeline.quote: As long as tyrants die, the chance for freedom lives.

citation.text: "Tyrants" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Kaya sinks through the floor and escapes.
timeline.quote: The stranger straightened her jacket smartly and dropped into the floor.

citation.text: "Tyrants" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Adriana takes up Brago's sword, deciding it is safest in her hands.
timeline.quote: Adriana's fingers grazed the hilt of Brago's sword.

citation.text: "Tyrants" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: The Custodi crown Marchesa as Queen of Paliano the next day.
timeline.quote: The Custodi crowned Queen Marchesa, the First of her Name, the following day.

citation.text: "Tyrants" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Adriana finds her guard shares her confusion and rage about the coup.
timeline.quote: Adriana was relieved to find all of them as deep in the dark as she was.

citation.text: "Tyrants" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Adriana realizes the coup took bribes to the Custodi, payment to the staff and to the assassin.
timeline.quote: Bribes to pay off the Custodi.

citation.text: "Tyrants" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Adriana confronts Marchesa about right of succession, and Marchesa says the Custodi accepted a legal will naming her heir.
timeline.quote: But the Custodi was very willing to accept properly filed legal documents.

citation.text: "Tyrants" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Marchesa reveals she dealt with Brago's descendants so that her name was next in succession.
timeline.quote: I dealt with them a while ago, however, and it just so happened that my name was next in the line of succession.

citation.text: "Tyrants" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Marchesa admits she paid Kaya to kill Brago.
timeline.quote: Well, Kaya killed Brago. Paid her good money for it, too.

citation.text: "Tyrants" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Marchesa offers Adriana a black-rose breastplate; Adriana refuses.
timeline.quote: You already know I'm not putting that on.

citation.text: "Tyrants" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Marchesa says that if the people call her a tyrant she will be tyrannical.
timeline.quote: Then I will be tyrannical

citation.text: "Tyrants" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Adriana spits in Marchesa's face and leaves with the breastplate.
timeline.quote: Adriana spat in the Queen's face.

citation.text: "Tyrants" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Adriana rides through the city dragging the rose breastplate behind her horse.
timeline.quote: tied the dreadful rose-adorned breastplate to a rope

citation.text: "Tyrants" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Marchesa publicly announces that the former captain has retired with a pension.
timeline.quote: The former captain has retired, with thanks from our fair city

citation.text: "Tyrants" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Members of Brago's guard secretly break their oaths to patrol the streets and protect citizens.
timeline.quote: Those who served in Brago's guard broke their oaths to the crown under cover of darkness

citation.text: "Tyrants" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Months later Adriana visits the elven explorer Selvala at her home.
timeline.quote: The elven explorer Selvala stood on the other side of the door

citation.text: "Tyrants" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Adriana proposes that Selvala serve as senator to halt Paliano's murderous monarchy.
timeline.quote: the finest nominee for a senator I can think of.

citation.text: "Tyrants" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Adriana asks Selvala to help build the Republic of Paliano.
timeline.quote: Will you help us build the Republic of Paliano?

citation.text: "Tyrants" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Marchesa announces to the people that King Brago is no more and has passed beyond the veil.
timeline.quote: Brago, King of Paliano, is no more.

citation.text: "Proclamation by Queen Marchesa" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Marchesa declares herself Brago's designated heir, recognized by the Custodi, and vows to uphold the laws of Paliano.
timeline.quote: As his designated heir, recognized by the sacred order of Custodi as his one true successor

citation.text: "Proclamation by Queen Marchesa" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Marchesa disbands the post of Captain of the Guard and puts the soldiers under her own command.
timeline.quote: the post of Captain of the Guard is disbanded.

citation.text: "Proclamation by Queen Marchesa" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Marchesa warns would-be rebels that treason will be met with the harshest punishments.
timeline.quote: treason will be answered, as it always has been, with the harshest punishments

citation.text: "Proclamation by Queen Marchesa" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Adriana tells the citizens they awoke as unwitting traitors under the banner of a usurper queen, Marchesa.
timeline.quote: You awoke as unwitting traitors beneath the bloodstained banner of a usurper queen

citation.work: Proclamation by Adriana, Captain of the Guard
citation.text: "Proclamation by Adriana, Captain of the Guard" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Adriana accuses Marchesa of murdering King Brago and forging his will and of commanding the Custodi.
timeline.quote: Somehow, this vile deceiver murdered King Brago

citation.work: Proclamation by Adriana, Captain of the Guard
citation.text: "Proclamation by Adriana, Captain of the Guard" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Adriana notes that the City Troops' banners have changed and that Marchesa avoids the city's symbol.
timeline.quote: But the banners of the City Troops have already changed.

citation.work: Proclamation by Adriana, Captain of the Guard
citation.text: "Proclamation by Adriana, Captain of the Guard" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Adriana declares she carries Brago's sword and, though stripped of her title, will not relinquish her duty to defend the city from the usurper.
timeline.quote: I know this because I now carry that sword

citation.work: Proclamation by Adriana, Captain of the Guard
citation.text: "Proclamation by Adriana, Captain of the Guard" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Adriana urges the citizens to stand with her and Brago and disobey the pretender.
timeline.quote: stand with me, and with Brago, and show your loyalty to your city through your disobedience to the pretender.

citation.work: Proclamation by Adriana, Captain of the Guard
citation.text: "Proclamation by Adriana, Captain of the Guard" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Paliano celebrates the Festival of Our Sovereign Lady's Grace while a lone sentry guards Fimarell's house.
timeline.quote: In the distance, the Festival of Our Sovereign Lady's Grace raged.

citation.text: "Bloody Instructions" by Shawn Main and Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: A mob of goblins pelts the sentry with vegetables and a firebomb to draw him from his post.
timeline.quote: Weapon raised, he raced for them.

citation.text: "Bloody Instructions" by Shawn Main and Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Daretti names Alendis, who apparently joined the Custodi, as his next target; Grenzo adds anyone in league with Marchesa.
timeline.quote: Sounds like the oily bastard joined the Custodi.

citation.text: "Bloody Instructions" by Shawn Main and Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Grenzo muses that Marchesa once ran in shadows but now locks every door, and proposes crashing all their parties.
timeline.quote: Now she's got her comfy chair and locks every door at night.

citation.text: "Bloody Instructions" by Shawn Main and Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Leovold notes that on the day of her ascension Marchesa decorated the throne room, guards and capital with Black Rose emblems, doubting her claim of Brago's will.
timeline.quote: the throne room is immediately decorated in Black Rose tapestries

citation.text: "Leovold's Dossiers" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Leovold relays rumors that an assassin infiltrated the palace, possibly walking through walls, to kill Brago, and that the queen's crown now glows with his energy.
timeline.quote: an assassin infiltrated the palace, by some accounts walking through stone walls, in order to reach Brago's chambers.

citation.text: "Leovold's Dossiers" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Leovold recounts that Selvala once drafted the Charter with Brago and was repaid with betrayal and imprisonment (backstory).
timeline.quote: She drafted the Charter alongside Brago

citation.text: "Leovold's Dossiers" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Leovold meets Selvala at a cafe, suggests a capable caretaker should rule, and promises her Trestian cousins' support.
timeline.quote: her cousins back in Trest would be extremely interested in supporting her in any of her future endeavors

citation.text: "Leovold's Dossiers" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Leovold observes that Adriana barely survived the queen's ascension and expects emissaries to keep pressing her.
timeline.quote: She has only narrowly survived the queen's ascension

citation.text: "Leovold's Dossiers" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Adriana rejects Leovold's overture; his messenger returns with a broken nose.
timeline.quote: the messenger returned with a broken nose and a completely ruined shirt.

citation.text: "Leovold's Dossiers" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Leovold concludes that Marchesa's persona as mother of assassins was a distraction and the throne was always her target.
timeline.quote: The throne was always her target.

citation.text: "Leovold's Dossiers" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Marchesa issues policies and proclamations drafted long before to consolidate power.
timeline.quote: Within hours of taking the throne, there have been proclamations and policies, clearly drafted weeks and months before.

citation.text: "Leovold's Dossiers" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Leovold makes an official outreach to Marchesa on Trest's behalf.
timeline.quote: I have made an official outreach on Trest's behalf.

citation.text: "Leovold's Dossiers" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Grenzo infiltrates Adriana's gatherings and turns peaceful demonstrations into violent mobs.
timeline.quote: He has twice now taken advantage of large gatherings assembled by Captain Adriana

citation.text: "Leovold's Dossiers" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: One of Leovold's attaches intercepts a dead drop containing the queen's dossier on Leovold.
timeline.quote: one of my diplomatic attachés interrupted a dead drop from one of the new queen's agents

citation.text: "Leovold's Dossiers" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Lucia Covi reports to Marchesa on Leovold, his parties and the embassy's possible spying.
timeline.quote: I have gathered the following information regarding the recently appointed ambassador from the city-state of Trest.

citation.text: "Leovold's Dossiers" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Leovold reports that Marchesa has replaced the city guard with loyal spies and assassins as she prepares to confront Adriana.
timeline.quote: The city guard has been largely thrown over in favor of troops loyal only to Marchesa

citation.text: "Leovold's Dossiers" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Adriana stages prison breaks to bring her former guards back to her side while Grenzo abdicates his post.
timeline.quote: Adriana has managed to stage some rather daring rescues to bring her former guards to her side

citation.text: "Leovold's Dossiers" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Leovold notes that Selvala and others look to exploit the unrest against the nobility.
timeline.quote: Some, including the illustrious and storied Selvala, are looking to take advantage of the unrest

citation.text: "Leovold's Dossiers" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Adriana pledges her sword to the city's defense, not the throne or the usurper.
timeline.quote: My sword is pledged to the defense of this city, not to the throne or this usurper.

citation.text: Adriana, Captain of the Guard (Conspiracy: Take the Crown, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Queen Marchesa's loyalists hail her as the true queen.
timeline.quote: Hail to the true queen! Long may she reign!

citation.text: Knights of the Black Rose (Conspiracy: Take the Crown, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Marchesa claims she offered her victims a choice.
timeline.quote: I did offer them a choice

citation.text: Capital Punishment (Conspiracy: Take the Crown, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Brago ruled Paliano on Fiora; after he died the Custodi kept his spirit as a figurehead to retain their command.
timeline.quote: kept his spirit as a figurehead and were able to retain their command for a while.

citation.text: "Conspiracy: Take the Crown", section "Flavor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaya eliminates Brago's spirit and the Black Rose confiscates the throne.
timeline.quote: The Black Rose confiscated the throne after Brago's spirit was eliminated by the planeswalker Kaya

citation.text: "Conspiracy: Take the Crown", section "Flavor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Queen Marchesa issues a proclamation and Captain Adriana answers it with a revolutionary speech.
timeline.quote: a revolutionary speech by Captain Adriana

citation.text: "Conspiracy: Take the Crown", section "Hidden message". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: One of Daretti's cogwork constructs explodes, apparently killing him; the blast ignites his spark and he planeswalks away, losing the use of his legs.
timeline.quote: In reality, the explosion ignited Daretti's Planeswalker's spark , and he planeswalked to relative safety.

citation.text: "Daretti", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Muzzio is blamed for Daretti's apparent death, letting the Academy remove two troublesome members.
timeline.quote: Daretti's apprentice Muzzio was blamed for the artificer's death

citation.text: "Daretti", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Marchesa is crowned, Daretti allies with disenfranchised goblins under Grenzo to take revenge, and his schemes lead to the Academy's disbanding.
timeline.quote: His schemes were responsible for the disbanding of the Academy

citation.text: "Daretti", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Daretti and Grenzo raid Professor Fimarell's home; Daretti discovers the plagiarism and kills Fimarell.
timeline.quote: After killing Fimarell, he and the other goblins turned their attention to the former academy members

citation.text: "Daretti", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After some time away, Daretti returns to Fiora to reshape the power structures of Paliano.
timeline.quote: After some time away, Daretti returned to Fiora to reshape the power structures of Paliano that denied him his aspirations.

citation.text: "Daretti". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Daretti's schemings cause the disbanding of the Academy.
timeline.quote: His schemings were responsible for the disbanding of the Academy

citation.text: "Daretti". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Daretti helps instigate the goblin riots to overturn Paliano's leadership and root out former Academy members.
timeline.quote: were instrumental in instigating the goblin riots

citation.text: "Daretti". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Muzzio takes on Irie as his apprentice since Irie could not afford the academy.
timeline.quote: Muzzio had seen the potential in him and brought him on as his apprentice

citation.text: "Irie", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Muzzio fails to secure the vote to become Chancellor and summons Irie.
timeline.quote: Muzzio had failed to secure the vote to become Chancellor of the Academy

citation.text: "Irie", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Muzzio shows Irie the secret lower workshop with more than a hundred constructs and a scale model of Paliano.
timeline.quote: more than a hundred mechanical constructs stood in rows

citation.text: "Irie", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Muzzio asks whether Irie thinks he has killed anyone and denies ever having done so.
timeline.quote: Muzzio denied having ever killed anyone

citation.text: "Irie", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Muzzio explains his constructs record what they hear onto wax cylinders to gather information.
timeline.quote: every construct in Paliano is either built with or from Muzzio's designs

citation.text: "Irie", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Muzzio tells Irie he hopes Fiora could become like places that blend machine perfection with organic life.
timeline.quote: Muzzio hoped Fiora one day could be like those places

citation.text: "Irie", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Brago seizes power and rules Paliano; he and the Custodi close the Academy to eliminate opponents.
timeline.quote: The King and his Custodi advisors closed down the Academy using the opportunity to eliminate those who stood against him.

citation.text: "Paliano", section "King Brago". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Brago attains immortality as a spirit with his advisors' help.
timeline.quote: he attained immortality with the help of his advisors which inadvertently freed him from his body as a spirit

citation.text: "Paliano", section "King Brago". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Selvala of Alberon kills Brago.
timeline.quote: Brago was killed by Selvala of Alberon

citation.text: "Paliano", section "King Brago". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Marchesa hires Kaya Cassir to eliminate Brago for good.
timeline.quote: hired the ghost assassin Kaya Cassir to eliminate the king for good

citation.text: "Paliano", section "Queen Marchesa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Adriana Vallore foments a rebellion against Queen Marchesa.
timeline.quote: Adriana Vallore fomented a rebellion against the new queen's reign

citation.text: "Paliano", section "Queen Marchesa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Daretti instigates goblin riots, but Marchesa's rule survives.
timeline.quote: However, these events were not successful in overthrowing her rule.

citation.text: "Paliano", section "Queen Marchesa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion, Marchesa refuses all trespassers.
timeline.quote: Queen Marchesa refused all who trespassed.

citation.text: "Paliano", section "Queen Marchesa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Selvala and Brago rise in Fiora's ruling class and draft the Charter.
timeline.quote: Together with Brago, she drafted the Charter.

citation.text: "Selvala of Alberon", section "Youth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Selvala kills the incurably ill, over-treated King Brago with a dagger as an act of mercy.
timeline.quote: Selvala ended his suffering with a dagger through his heart.

citation.text: "Selvala of Alberon", section "Murderer". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Custodi throw Selvala into the dungeons for murder.
timeline.quote: the Custodi threw her into the dungeons for murder

citation.text: "Selvala of Alberon", section "Murderer". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Grenzo releases Selvala to kill Muzzio; she frees the constructs in his tunnels and leaves the High City.
timeline.quote: Selvala left the High City and went back to the wild places far below and far beyond.

citation.text: "Selvala of Alberon", section "Release". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaya kills Brago's spirit and the Black Rose usurps the crown.
timeline.quote: Brago's spirit was killed by the planeswalker Kaya

citation.text: "Selvala of Alberon", section "Reign of the Black Rose". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Captain Adriana approaches Selvala to help remove the monarchy and build the Republic.
timeline.quote: help get rid of the monarchy and help build the Republic of Paliano

citation.text: "Selvala of Alberon", section "Reign of the Black Rose". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Brago is king of the High City.
relations.quote: The king, Brago, skin pale and cracked, like old parchment paper, rested in an ornate chair.

citation.text: "Betrayal" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 May 2014.

relations.note: Her mansion is among the elite homes of the High City.
relations.quote: Situated among the elite of Paliano, the High City

citation.text: "The Black Rose" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 May 2014.

relations.note: Reached through the tunnels beneath Paliano.

citation.text: Selvala, Explorer Returned (Conspiracy, 2014), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

citation.text: Deathreap Ritual (Conspiracy, 2014), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

citation.text: Ornithopter (Magic 2015, 2014), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

relations.quote: the velvet-drenched queen of the High City of Paliano

relations.quote: sole sovereign of the High City

citation.text: "Proclamation by Queen Marchesa" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2016.
